turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Hi, Doctor. Well, I came in today because... the thought of getting on an airplane right now just scares me so bad. I mean, I know it doesn't make sense in my head, but my body just tells me that the plane is going to fall right out of the sky. It's just gotten really hard to deal with.

symptom_reasoning.S062: The patient describes an intense fear of getting on an airplane and feeling like it will crash, recognizing that the fear is out of proportion to actual danger.

turns.doctor_question: Besides flying, are there other situations or things that make you feel this same kind of intense fear or anxiety?
turns.patient_response: No, not really. It's... it's just the flying. I mean, I don't have this problem with anything else. Heights are fine, elevators are fine. It's specifically just being on an airplane that does it to me.

symptom_reasoning.S062: The patient confirms that being on an airplane specifically provokes intense fear and anxiety, consistent with a situational specific phobia.
